headline: GIFT Nifty signals positive start; markets remain cautious after RBI rate hike and rising oil prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: RBI's recent rate hike has prompted state-owned banks to increase repo-linked lending rates by 25 bps
Concerns over rising crude oil prices and a weakening rupee are exerting downward pressure on Dalal Street
Geopolitical tensions and AI-related risks are creating a weak growth outlook for the Indian IT sector
The India VIX has surged 10%, reflecting increased investor anxiety following recent market volatility
whatHappening: GIFT Nifty indicates a positive start for the Indian market today despite a decline in Asian peers
Three SME IPOs—Acme India Industries, TNA Solutions, and Paramount Syntex—are listing on the exchanges today
Crude oil prices dipped 1% to $103 after geopolitical concerns regarding Iran were temporarily eased
Major Indian indices recently touched 52-week lows as the Sensex plummeted over 1,000 points in a single session
summary: Indian markets are expected to open higher following GIFT Nifty cues, despite recent heavy losses and an RBI rate hike. Investors are monitoring rising oil prices and a weak rupee, while state-owned banks have begun raising lending rates. Three SME IPOs—Acme India Industries, TNA Solutions, and Paramount Syntex—are scheduled to list on the exchanges today.
